cinematic_dialogue:1:1321799002:.text: You're the one who refused to help Yolena!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1321799002:.source_cn: 你……你是那个不肯帮亚莲娜的祖先！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1321718002:.text: Of course! Who do you think made it?
cinematic_dialogue:1:1321718002:.source_cn: 那是！也不看看是谁的手艺？
